preconditions.description: Both message and hashtag must be strings.
The hashtag must consist only of alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.expression: message.find(hashtag) == -1 or message.startswith(hashtag) or message.find(hashtag) == message.find(hashtag) + len(hashtag)
postconditions.description: If the hashtag is not found at the beginning or in the middle of the message, the message remains unchanged.

postconditions.expression: message.find(hashtag) != -1 and not message.startswith(hashtag) and message.find(hashtag) == message.find(hashtag) + len(hashtag)
postconditions.description: If the hashtag is found in the middle of the message, it is removed and the message is returned with a single space where the hashtag was.
